meta.name: seo-content-audit
meta.description: E-E-A-T + CITE quality audit for an EXISTING piece of content. Scores Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness, and citation-readiness for AI search; surfaces veto items that block publication; produces a publish / publish-with-fixes / no-publish verdict. Distinct from `seo-content-brief` (produces a NEW article from a topic) and from `seo-page` (URL-level keyword/traffic intelligence). Use when the user asks "content quality audit", "E-E-A-T check", "is this content good", "review this article", "content audit", "citation readiness", or "AI search readiness".
